reviewed_candidate.settlement_scope: Assumed standard rules; not yet checked against this book's published rules. Standard full-game only; verify local rules and market exceptions
reviewed_candidate.model_status: Experimental independent forecast; no validated betting edge

inputs.label: Opponent goals allowed / game
inputs.detail: Recency-weighted; the same figure the game-line model uses

inputs.label: His results vs. our forecasts
inputs.detail: 278 actual vs. 282.2 forecast points in earlier games; shrunk toward 1

steps.label: Opponent goals allowed vs. long-run league average
His results vs. our past forecasts

build.note: Ice time × production per 60 minutes, both recency-weighted and blended with a position average, then scaled by how many goals the opponent allows compared with the league. Then adjusted for how he has done against our own forecasts: 278 points against 282.2 forecast in his earlier games, shrunk toward no adjustment. The model then turns this average into the chance of each count.

blend.label: Production rate
blend.detail: Recency-weighted games; the rest is the position average

blend.label: Ice time
blend.detail: Recency-weighted games; the rest is the position average

trend.label: assists
trend.note: Faded games count less. A game’s weight halves every 110 of his games for production and every 14 of his games for ice time.

missing: The starting goalie (team defense blends its goalies)

versus.note: History only, not a model input. In our backtests, results against one opponent did not predict the next meeting beyond a player’s overall form.

player_context.note: Newer appearances carry more weight. Ice time has a 14-appearance half-life; production per minute has a 110-appearance half-life. The offseason does not age player history. Expected shots scale with the opponent’s shots allowed, and scoring with its goals allowed, relative to the league. A player who has consistently beaten (or missed) our earlier forecasts gets a shrunk adjustment toward that record. Observed averages below are unweighted. Participation and current role remain unconfirmed.

key_drivers: Projected ice time 18.3 minutes; separately shrunk production rate
uncertainties: Line and power-play assignment not verified
invalidation_conditions: New goalie, lineup or injury information
reviewed_candidate.goalie_assumption: Projected, not confirmed. Opposing goalie, Toronto Maple Leafs: likely Sergei Bobrovsky 61% (sv 0.889), Anthony Stolarz 39%.
reviewed_candidate.lineup_assumption: Participation required for action; current role and active lineup unconfirmed

sensitivity.assumption: Production/opportunity means ±10%; not a confidence interval

reviewed_candidate.review: Price or forecast changed · research needs recheck

review_context.validation: Experimental; no established executable betting edge

assessment.reason: The model's fair price near -178 is shorter than the -135 offer, and the full sensitivity range stays above break-even. No specific unresolved fact was identified that would flip the case.
assessment.model_case: The projected mean is under half an assist, with a median of zero, built on 164 appearances and about 18 projected minutes. The weak point is power-play assignment, which is unverified. A top power-play role could lift his assist rate above the shrunk estimate.
assessment.price_case: This is the standard 0.5 line at -135, which needs roughly 57 in 100 to break even. Only one other book is available for comparison, and the market estimate sits just above break-even. Settlement rules are assumed standard and have not been checked against this book.
assessment.context_case: Edmonton has several absences on defense and at center that could reshuffle deployment in either direction. It is unknown whether the model reflects them. Toronto's goalie is projected, not confirmed.

qualitative_review.countercase: Nugent-Hopkins may play heavy power-play minutes against a weaker projected goalie. If injuries push him into a larger setup role, his assist rate could exceed the model's shrunk estimate and leave the under overpriced at -135.
open_checks: Confirm his power-play unit and line in pregame reports
Verify BetMGM settlement rules for assists, including overtime
Reconfirm Toronto's starting goalie and the -135 price

evidence.interpretation: If Ekholm is absent, Edmonton's defensive and power-play deployment may shift. Effects on Nugent-Hopkins' assist chances could run either way.
